items.claim: A throwing or rejecting `show`/`preview` fails the whole run and leaks that stage's bitmaps
A `many` input gets only its first wire's value
items.note: Question: the evaluator now gets an array of every reached wire's value, and a bypassed stage passes the first one on. Nobody had ruled on this, so it's logged in `docs/unruled.md`. Its changeset is `major` + `breaking`, because an evaluator with a `many` input now reads `unknown[]`.
An option set to `undefined` now goes back to its default (`evaluators` excepted), and `setSources(undefined)` is accepted.

items.claim: `useEffectRunner` keeps an option the caller stops passing
`mainChain` caches a path a loop cut short, so the answer depends on stage order
items.note: Cut paths are no longer cached, up to a 20,000-stage walk budget so a dense loop still finishes.

items.claim: `freeSpot` loops forever on a view far from the origin
items.note: Before the fix this hangs, so the new test can't be shown failing; a node loop capped at 10⁶ steps confirmed the hang.

items.claim: A `~lane:` stage id collides with the lanes look's lane nodes
items.note: The same fault was in `rack`'s `~tap:`/`~skip-*` port ids, so the fix covers both. Question: every stage and port id starting with `~` is now reserved; `checkPipeline` reports it as `reserved-id`, and `rack` and `lanes` throw naming it. This is also logged in `docs/unruled.md`.
